name: youtube-upload
notes: Modelled on YouTube Studio's upload dialog as recorded by a signed-in run on 2026-10-31 (Chrome 156, components in the light DOM; packs/youtube/skills/youtube-studio-upload/references/studio-ui.md) and on YouTube Help answer 57407 for the page order (Details, Video elements, Checks, Visibility); not run through this preset against live Studio. Tested against a fixture copy (test/platform-fixtures/youtube-upload.html). Visibility is fixed to Unlisted and the audience answer to 'not made for kids': both are part of what the person approves when they approve this preset. signedIn: ytcp-button#create-icon, Studio's Create button; Studio never renders signed out (it redirects to accounts.google.com), and the same id is used by ContentAutomation/YouTubeUploader. Step 'aria/Upload videos': the Create menu item by its accessible name, as pressed on 2026-10-31 (the older tp-yt-paper-item[test-id=upload-beta] is from 2021). Video: the input[type=file] (name Filedata) inside ytcp-uploads-file-picker, seen in the light DOM on 2026-10-31; setting it starts the upload at once and the video is saved as Private until Save, so a later failed step leaves a private draft in the channel. The wait on #title-textarea #textbox (up to 60 s) is the Details page appearing. Title and Description: the contenteditable #textbox inside #title-textarea and #description-textarea (2026-10-31); Studio prefills the title with the file name and the fill replaces it. Studio caps the title at 100 and the description at 5,000 characters. Thumbnail: input#file-loader inside ytcp-thumbnail-uploader (2026-10-31, also linouk23/youtube_uploader_selenium); on a channel without phone verification the input takes the file and nothing happens, so the post goes out with an automatic thumbnail. Audience: tp-yt-paper-radio-button[name=VIDEO_MADE_FOR_KIDS_NOT_MFK] (the name ContentAutomation/YouTubeUploader clicks by), then a check that it is aria-checked; Studio will not leave Details unanswered. Next: #next-button inside ytcp-uploads-dialog (both public projects use the id; 2026-10-31 pressed it by its name, Next), clicked three times to pass Details, Video elements and Checks; ytcp-uploads-video-elements is waited for after the first. Captions, only when the Captions file is given, follow the 2026-10-31 runbook: the 'Add' ytcp-button in the Subtitles row of Video elements (the one whose row says Subtitles and not End screen), then the button whose text starts with 'Upload file' outside the thumbnail uploader, then 'Continue' (With timing is preselected), which opens the system file picker: the Captions slot names that button and the browser hands the picker the file, then 'Done'. Those four are XPath by visible text and are the least certain part of this preset. Visibility: tp-yt-paper-radio-button[name=UNLISTED] (linouk23 selects visibility radios by this name), clicked, then checked aria-checked=true at park AND again at confirm, so a page that drifted off Unlisted is never saved. submit: #done-button inside ytcp-uploads-dialog, labelled Save for an unlisted video (both public projects). receipt: the https://youtu.be/<id> link in ytcp-video-share-dialog, the dialog Studio opens after Save (2026-10-31 saw the link there; the share dialog's element name is from public automation). The same youtu.be link is already beside the preview before Save, outside that dialog, so it is not mistaken for the receipt. Confirm re-reads Title and Description on the Details page, which Studio hides (not removes) while Visibility shows; if a build removes it, confirm fails as 'changed since shown' and nothing is saved. A brand-new channel first shows a Welcome dialog: the person dismisses it once in browser_view.
